arxiv-2006-15527.title: BER Analysis of RIS Assisted Multicast Communications with Network Coding
arxiv-2006-15527.creator: Vetrivel Chelian Thirumavalavan, PGS Velmurugan, Thiruvengadam S J
arxiv-2006-15527.description: Abstract In this paper, Reconﬁgurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) assisted dual-hop multicast wireless communication network is proposed with two source nodes and two destination nodes. RIS boosts received signal strength through an intelligent software-controlled array of discrete phase-shifting metamaterials. The multicast communication from the source nodes is enabled using a Decode and Forward (DF) relay node.

arxiv-2109-00970.title: Construction of Inter-Group Complementary Code Set and 2-D Z-Complementary Array Code Set Based on Multivariable Functions
arxiv-2109-00970.creator: Abhishek Roy, and Sudhan Majhi
arxiv-2109-00970.description: Abstract The need of two dimensional (2-D) arrays with good 2-D correlation properties have been found of great interest in research because of the rapid development of the modern technologies in the field of wireless communications. 2-D arrays have found various applications wireless communication technologies such as ultra-wide band (UWB), 2-D synchronization, phased array antenna etc.

arxiv-2202-01155.title: The slurk Interaction Server Framework: Better Data for Better Dialog Models
arxiv-2202-01155.description: Abstract This paper presents the slurk software, a lightweight interaction server for setting up dialog data collections and running experiments. slurk enables a multitude of settings including text-based, speech and video interaction between two or more humans or humans and bots, and a multimodal display area for presenting shared or private interactive context.

arxiv-2202-03647.title: SUMMARY ON THE ICASSP 2022 MULTI-CHANNEL MULTI-PARTY MEETING TRANSCRIPTION GRAND CHALLENGE
arxiv-2202-03647.creator: Fan Yu 1,3 , Shiliang Zhang 1 , Pengcheng Guo 3 , Yihui Fu 3 , Zhihao Du 1 , Siqi Zheng 1 , Weilong Huang 1 , Lei Xie 3∗ , Zheng-Hua Tan 5 , DeLiang Wang 6 , Yanmin Qian 7 , Kong Aik Lee 8 , Zhijie Yan 1 , Bin Ma 2 , Xin Xu 4 , Hui Bu 4
arxiv-2202-03647.description: Abstract The ICASSP 2022 Multi-channel Multi-party Meeting Transcription Grand Challenge (M2MeT) focuses on one of the most valuable and the most challenging scenarios of speech technologies. The M2MeT challenge has particularly set up two tracks, speaker diarization (track 1) and multi-speaker automatic speech recognition (ASR) (track 2).

arxiv-2203-14475.title: Zwicky Transient Facility and Globular Clusters: The RR Lyrae g ​ r ​ i gri -Band Period-Luminosity-Metallicity and Period-Wesenheit-Metallicity Relations astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , dustmaps ( Green 2018 ) , gatspy ( VanderPlas & Ivezić 2015 )
arxiv-2203-14475.creator: Chow-Choong Ngeow, Anupam Bhardwaj, Richard Dekany, Dmitry A. Duev, Matthew J. Graham, Steven L. Groom, Ashish A. Mahabal, Frank J. Masci, Michael S. Medford, Reed Riddle
arxiv-2203-14475.description: Abstract Based on time-series observations collected from Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF), we derived period-luminosity-metallicity (PLZ) and period-Wesenheit-metallicity (PWZ) relations for RR Lyrae located in globular clusters. We have applied various selection criteria to exclude RR Lyrae with problematic or spurious light curves.

arxiv-2206-11460.title: pyKT : A Python Library to Benchmark Deep Learning based Knowledge Tracing Models
arxiv-2206-11460.creator: Zitao Liu, Qiongqiong Liu, Jiahao Chen, Shuyan Huang, Jiliang Tang, Weiqi Luo
arxiv-2206-11460.description: Abstract Knowledge tracing (KT) is the task of using students’ historical learning interaction data to model their knowledge mastery over time so as to make predictions on their future interaction performance. Recently, remarkable progress has been made of using various deep learning techniques to solve the KT problem.

arxiv-2405-20533.title: On zero entropy homeomorphisms of the pseudo-arc
arxiv-2405-20533.creator: Jernej Činč
arxiv-2405-20533.description: Abstract . In this paper we study interval maps f f with zero topological entropy that are crooked; i.e. whose inverse limit with f f as the single bonding map is the pseudo-arc. We show that there are uncountably many pairwise non-conjugate zero entropy crooked interval maps with different sets of fixed points.

pmc-11405679.title: Interactive computer-aided diagnosis on medical image using large language models
pmc-11405679.creator: Sheng Wang, Zihao Zhao, Xi Ouyang, Tianming Liu, Qian Wang, Dinggang Shen
pmc-11405679.description: Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) has advanced medical image analysis, while large language models (LLMs) have shown potential in clinical applications. However, LLMs struggle to interpret medical images, which are critical for decision-making. Here we show a strategy integrating LLMs with CAD networks.

pmc-11547577.title: Reusable SERS Platform of Femtosecond Laser Processed Substrate for Detection of Malachite Green
pmc-11547577.creator: Yinghao Lun, Bing Zhao, Yuanhai Geng, Wenhan Du, Xiaona Zhao, Xuan Wang, Victor A Nadtochenko
pmc-11547577.description: This study presents the development of highly efficient Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering (SERS) substrates through femtosecond (fs) laser processing of crystalline silicon (Si), resulting in mountain-like microstructures. These microstructures, when decorated with gold nanoparticles (Au NPs), exhibit remarkable SERS performance due to the creation of concentrated hotspots.

pmc-11608551.title: Pathogen Distribution of Neonatal Bacterial Meningitis in the Era of Multidrug-Resistant Bacteria: A Single-Center Experience
pmc-11608551.creator: Minli Zhu, Jing Lin, Zhangming Zhuge, Yihui Zheng, Shuyan Ye, Xun Wang, Jianghu Zhu, Shangqin Chen, Zhenlang Lin
pmc-11608551.description: PurposeNeonatal bacterial meningitis (NBM) is a serious disease with high morbidity and mortality. This study aimed to establish a foundation for the selection of empirical antibiotics for NBM through an analysis of pathogen distribution and shift in antimicrobial resistant pattern.Patients and MethodsA retrospective cohort study on culture confirmed NBM from 2005 to 2022.

pmc-11644560.title: Effect of Insecticides Imidacloprid and Alpha-Cypermethrin on the Development of Pea (Pisum sativum L.) Nodules
pmc-11644560.creator: Artemii P Gorshkov, Pyotr G Kusakin, Maxim G Vorobiev, Anna V Tsyganova, Viktor E Tsyganov, João Paulo Arantes Rodrigues Da Cunha
pmc-11644560.description: Insecticides are used commonly in agricultural production to defend plants, including legumes, from insect pests. It is a known fact that insecticides can have a harmful effect on the legume–rhizobial symbiosis. In this study, the effects of systemic seed treatment insecticide Imidor Pro (imidacloprid) and foliar insecticide Faskord (alpha-cypermethrin) on the structural organization of pea (Pisum sativum L.

pmc-11679911.title: Effects of Cr3+ Doping on Spinel LiMn2O4 Morphology and Electrochemical Performance
pmc-11679911.creator: Zhengqing Pei, Jiawei Wang, Haifeng Wang, Kexin Zheng, Qian Wang, Xinjie Zhou, Dehua Ma, Ju Lu
pmc-11679911.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). LiMn2O4, a significant cathode material for lithium-ion batteries, has garnered considerable attention due to its low cost and environmental friendliness. However, its widespread application is constrained by its rapid capacity degradation and short cycle life at elevated temperatures. To enhance the electrochemical performance of LiMn2O4, we employed a liquid-phase co-precipitation and calcination method to incorporate Cr3+ into the LiMn2O4 cathode material, successfully synthesizing a series of LiCrxMn2−xO4 (x = 0~0.06).

pmc-12446134.title: Precision epigenetic therapies in oncology
pmc-12446134.creator: Arundhati Chaudhary, Kayleigh J. A. Orchard, Francesca Salani, Theodora Partsou, Mark Eccleston, Guido Bocci, Antoine Italiano, Francesco Crea
pmc-12446134.description: Phenotypic plasticity is a key mechanism of metastatic progression and cancer therapy resistance. This hallmark of human malignancies is enabled by highly conserved epigenetic mechanisms that control gene expression. Functional alterations in DNA methylation and histone post-translational modifications have been extensively described as drivers of metastatic dissemination and therapy resistance.

pmc-12484200.title: Red cell distribution width as a prognostic indicator in medical and surgical ICU patients
pmc-12484200.creator: Aski Vural, Fadime Cinar, Semra Bulbuloglu, Arife Karamelek
pmc-12484200.description: BackgroundRed cell distribution width (RDW) has been investigated as a clinical predictor in different study populations. However, its prognostic usefulness in medical and surgical intensive care units remains unknown. This study investigates the role of RDW as a prognostic factor in this specific patient population.

pmc-12528502.title: Anatomically informed deep learning framework for generating fast, low-dose synthetic CBCT for prostate radiotherapy
pmc-12528502.creator: Mustafa Kadhim, Emilia Persson, André Haraldsson, Christian Jamtheim Gustafsson, Mikael Nilsson, Malin Kügele, Sven Bäck, Sofie Ceberg
pmc-12528502.description: Precise patient positioning and daily anatomical verification are crucial in external beam radiotherapy to ensure accurate dose delivery and minimize harm to healthy tissues. However, Current image-guided radiotherapy techniques struggle to balance high-quality volumetric anatomical visualization and rapid low-dose imaging.

pmc-12556411.title: A systematic review of digital interventions for loneliness and social isolation
pmc-12556411.creator: T Hansen
pmc-12556411.description: As loneliness and social isolation emerge as pressing public health concerns, identifying effective interventions is essential. Digital solutions offer flexible, scalable, and cost-effective approaches, yet their effectiveness remains uncertain. This systematic review and meta-analysis assess the impact of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on digital interventions to reduce loneliness and social isolation.

pmc-12757414.title: Rifapentine- and moxifloxacin-containing short-course regimens for mild spinal tuberculosis: study protocol for a multicenter, randomized, non-inferiority phase II clinical trial
pmc-12757414.creator: Yue-E Wu, Jing Cao, Li Wang, Ying-Ji Wei, Hui-Xin Liu, Lei Qi, Wen Zhang, Feng Liu, Zhong-Jiao Zhu, Xu-Tao Fan, Sheng Wang, Cong Chen, Xiang-Ze Liu, Ying Li, Zhong-Zheng Sun, Jing-Bo Pan, Chao-Qun Yang, John Van Den Anker, Qiang Zhang, Wei Zhao
pmc-12757414.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundSpinal tuberculosis is the most common form of osteoarticular infection, with recommended anti-tuberculosis treatment durations typically being long (9–18 months), even for mild cases, increasing the risks of drug resistance, toxicity, and poor patient adherence.

pmc-13457726.title: Association of stress hyperglycemia ratio on right ventricular dysfunction and biventricular coupling in patients with acute coronary syndrome assessed by CMR feature tracking: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13457726.creator: Pei-Lun Han, Ji-Er Ma, Ye Deng, Ge Zhang, Jing Liu, Wei-Feng Yan, Li-Ting Shen, Zhu-Lin Feng, Xiao-Ling Wen, Zhi-Gang Yang
pmc-13457726.description: BackgroundAmong individuals diagnosed with acute coronary syndrome (ACS), the stress hyperglycemia ratio (SHR) has been demonstrated to correlate with an elevated risk of unfavorable cardiovascular events. However, the relationship between SHR, right ventricular (RV) function and biventricular interdependence has not yet been reported.

pmc-13624775.title: Feasibility and diagnostic performance of heparinized wet-suction and single-pass single-needle actuation endoscopic ultrasound-guided tissue acquisition for subepithelial lesions in Japan: a single-center retrospective study
pmc-13624775.creator: Kotaro Takeshita, Satoshi Asai, Kenji Matsuo, Takumi Sugihara, Kensei Kawasaki, Aoi Koizumi, Sayuri Hashimoto, Kaho Takagi, Yoshihiro Shima, Tomoya Hashimura, Kento Hisamatsu, Yuma Fujita, Yuichiro Hamamoto, Shuta Otachi, Yuki Kano, Eisuke Nakao, Eisuke Akamine, Yoshinobu Hirose
pmc-13624775.description: Background/AimsHeparinized wet suction (HEP) and the single-pass single-needle actuation method (HEP1p1a) are promising for endoscopic ultrasound-guided tissue acquisition (EUS-TA) because they improve specimen quality. However, its applicability in the biopsy of subepithelial lesions (SELs) remains unexamined. Therefore, this study evaluated the clinical utility of EUS-TA using HEP1p1a in SELs.
